description_en: Queries the information about custom images in a region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下一个或多个已创建的自定义镜像信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open list-custom-images --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --image-ids '["fe9c66133a9d4688872869726b52****","794c230fd3e64ea19f83f4d7a0ad****"]' --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --image-names '["test1****","test2****"]' --system-snapshot-id s-bp14m09pq80000g6 --data-snapshot-id s-acscasca0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --resource-group-id rg-aek2bti7cf7yj2i --share false --instance-id ace0706b2ac4454d984295a942130000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomImages

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers corresponding to the custom images. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The image IDs of the simple application server. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 image IDs. Separate multiple image IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的镜像ID。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: image_ids

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100。
默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh:
快照列表的页码。
默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The image names of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 image names. Separate multiple image names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器的镜像名称。取值可以由多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: image_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the system disk snapshot
parameters.name: system_snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data disk snapshot
parameters.name: data_snapshot_id

fields.help_en: The key of tag N. A tag key can be 1 to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of tag N. A tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20
fields.help_zh: 自定义镜像的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: Tag N of the custom image
parameters.help_zh: 自定义镜像的标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query shared images. Valid values:

False: do not query shared images. The shared images are not included in the response.

True: query shared images. The shared images are included in the response.

If you do not specify this parameter, all images are returned
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询共享镜像。取值范围：

False：否。表示返回结果中不包括共享镜像。

True：是。表示只返回共享镜像。

不填则默认返回所有镜像
parameters.name: share

parameters.help_en: The ID of the simple application server from which the image is derived
parameters.help_zh: 镜像的来源轻量应用服务器实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id
